title: LIBER Position on the Future of the European Open Science Cloud
what_changed: LIBER proposes maintaining EOSC beyond 2027 as a distinct, Work Programme-based European Partnership under FP10. It asks that research libraries be recognised as EOSC supporting infrastructure, included in governance and implementation, and made directly eligible in future funding calls.
why_it_matters: The paper identifies an institutional "last-mile" problem: European infrastructure may exist technically without organisations capable of integrating it into everyday research practice. Its proposed solution assigns libraries a formal intermediary role rather than treating them merely as service users.
